radio.$description: Single size only, same rationale as Checkbox — a fixed-size control, not a field grid. Native <input type="radio"> stays in the DOM (visually hidden) so grouping/keyboard/forms work for free. Unlike Checkbox, the checked state never fills the whole circle — only the outline recolors plus a small inner dot appears, the convention every reference (Radix/MUI/Ant/Material) uses to keep radio visually distinct from checkbox at a glance. The dot is a plain CSS circle (border-radius + background), not an icon asset — there's no glyph simple enough to need one.

circle.$description: 20px outer circle — same footprint as Checkbox's box, so the two line up when used near each other.

dot.$description: 8px inner dot, 40% of the circle — visibly smaller than the outline it sits in, per every reference checked.

borderWidth.$description: 2px, same reasoning as Checkbox's borderWidth — a 1px ring nearly disappears at this size.

label.$description: Same 14px normal weight as Checkbox's label — both are static text beside a fixed-size control.

checked.$description: bg stays surface.default (not filled) — border and dot both resolve to fill.primary (not the paler border.primary role, which is blue.200 vs. fill.primary's blue.500 — pairing a pale ring with a saturated dot read as mismatched/broken when checked). Same same-value border+fill pairing Checkbox's checked state uses.

disabledChecked.$description: Border falls back to border.default rather than border.primary while disabled — brand blue should never show on an inert control.

group.$description: RadioGroup composes plain Radio items under an optional heading + helper text — no group-level error state, same as CheckboxGroup.
